title: Cookies, Headers & Form Data
summary: Read cookies and headers, handle form data submissions, and set response cookies.

sections.content: Cookie(...) reads request cookies. Set cookies via response.set_cookie(...).

sections.title: Underscore conversion
sections.content: By default, Header() converts underscores to hyphens (user_agent matches User-Agent). Use convert_underscores=False to disable this.
Use Form() to accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded data (normal HTML form posts). Requires python-multipart.

sections.title: Form vs JSON
sections.content: Form() expects form-encoded data. If your client sends JSON, use a Pydantic model (BaseModel) instead. Both can't be used for the same parameter.

sections.title: Security best practice
sections.content: For browser apps, use secure=True, httponly=True, samesite='lax' on cookies to prevent XSS and CSRF attacks.

interact.title: Header & Cookie Inspector
interact.description: See how headers and cookies are parsed by FastAPI.

quiz.question: How do you read a cookie from the request?
quiz.explanation: You can use Cookie() as a parameter annotation (recommended) or access request.cookies directly. Cookie() gives you type validation and auto-docs.

quiz.question: What does Header() do with underscores by default?
quiz.explanation: Header() converts underscores to hyphens by default (user_agent matches User-Agent). Use convert_underscores=False to disable.

quiz.question: What content type does Form() expect?
quiz.explanation: Form() expects application/x-www-form-urlencoded (standard HTML form posts). For file uploads, use UploadFile with multipart/form-data.

quiz.question: Which package is required for Form() to work?
quiz.explanation: python-multipart is required for parsing form data. Install it with pip install python-multipart.

quiz.question: What security flags should you set on cookies for browser apps?
quiz.explanation: secure=True (HTTPS only), httponly=True (no JS access), samesite='lax' (CSRF protection) are the recommended security flags for browser cookies.
